arxiv-2108-11578.title: A Unified Approach for Constructing Confidence Intervals and Hypothesis Tests Using h-function
arxiv-2108-11578.creator: Weizhen Wang
arxiv-2108-11578.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Weizhen Wang. We introduce a general method, named the h-function method, to unify the constructions of level- α \alpha exact test and 1 − α 1-\alpha exact confidence interval. Using this method, any confidence interval is improved as follows: i) an approximate interval, including a point estimator, is modified to an exact interval; ii) an exact interval is refined to be an interval that is a subset of the previous one. Two real datasets are used to illustrate the method.

pmc-10657522.title: Patient Care Gaps Prior to Maintenance Dialysis Initiation: A Population-Based Retrospective Study
pmc-10657522.creator: Amber O. Molnar, Danielle M. Nash, Jennifer Emblem, Sarah Bota, Eric McArthur, Bin Luo, Yaqing Liu, Amit X. Garg, Peter G. Blake, K. Scott Brimble
pmc-10657522.description: Background:Guidelines in Ontario, Canada, recommend timely referral for multidisciplinary kidney care to facilitate planned dialysis initiation. Many patients do not receive recommended multidisciplinary kidney care prior to dialysis.Objective:To better understand why this gap in pre-dialysis care exists, we conducted a study to describe the pathways by which patients initiate maintenance dialysis.Design:A retrospective cohort study.

pmc-11620132.title: Characterization of mechanical and temperature effects on delamination and basic strength behaviors of PVC coated PUR foam substrate used in bus dashboard
pmc-11620132.creator: Niyazi Oral, Okan Otuz, Rafet Kemal Kocabıyık, Mustafa Akoğlu
pmc-11620132.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study focuses on the delamination and characterization of different loadings and temperature conditions of polyvinyl chloride (PVC)-coated polyurethane (PUR) foam component layers commonly used in bus dashboards. The method was developed through mechanical and thermal tests.The study involves the examination of primer and no primer PVC-coated PUR components using SEM (Scanning Electron Microscope), tensile-compression, three-point bending, primer characterization, peel, PUR material thermal expansion, and thermal tests.

pmc-12631326.title: Work-family interfaces and leaders’ knowledge hiding: underlying mechanisms and contingencies
pmc-12631326.creator: Min Min, Kai Fang, Zhen Zhang, Ziyue Xu
pmc-12631326.description: ObjectivesThe current study aims to examine the effects of work interference with family (WIF) and family interference with work (FIW) on leaders’ knowledge hiding, as well as the mediating role of affective organizational commitment and the contingent role of organization-based self-esteem.

pmc-12694334.title: Single-Cell Omics in Legumes: Research Trends and Applications
pmc-12694334.creator: Yaohua Li, Md Sabbir Hossain, Marc Libault
pmc-12694334.description: Legumes are important food crops and play a central role in sustainable agriculture through their ability to form symbiosis with rhizobia, soil bacteria that fix atmospheric nitrogen. Recent advances in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, along with single-cell epigenomics, have enabled high-resolution analysis of gene expression dynamics and the prediction of cell-type-specific regulatory networks.

pmc-13194640.title: PRSS23 promotes ovarian cancer peritoneal dissemination independent of protease activity
pmc-13194640.creator: Sharoon Akhtar, Matt Coban, Erin Miller, Alexandra Hockla, Eran Maina, Christine Mehner, Stefan Ilic, Niv Papo, Derek C Radisky, Evette S Radisky
pmc-13194640.description: Ovarian cancer metastasizes via peritoneal dissemination, requiring tumor cells to resist detachment-induced cell death (anoikis) in suspension and to reinitiate proliferation after seeding. Because disseminating ovarian cancer cells persist in malignant ascites enriched in extracellular S1 family serine proteases, we surveyed S1 protease gene expression across ovarian cancer cohorts to identify those most associated with poor outcomes.

pmc-13328555.title: Measuring and increasing the brain health span across adulthood: a public health imperative
pmc-13328555.creator: Lori G. Cook, Jeffrey S. Spence, Zhengsi Chang, Erin E. Venza, Aaron Tate, Ian H. Robertson, Mark D’Esposito, Geoffrey S. F. Ling, Jane G. Wigginton, Sandra Bond Chapman
pmc-13328555.description: Extending brain health span – maintaining or improving cognitive, social, and emotional well-being – is critical to aligning health span with lifespan. This study examines 3-year outcomes from 3,966 adults (ages 19–94) in the BrainHealth Project, an online initiative integrating the BrainHealth Index (BHI) with cognitive training, lifestyle modules, and coaching.

pmc-13339481.title: Intergenerational transmission of anxiety: A comparison of transdiagnostic and disorder‐specific pathways
pmc-13339481.creator: Hyunsik Kim, Lifang Pan, Ardesheer Talati, Marc J Gameroff, Myrna M Weissman, Helen Blair Simpson
pmc-13339481.description: BackgroundIndividuals with a parental history of anxiety disorders are at risk of developing an anxiety disorder. Prior studies have focused on the transmission of specific anxiety disorders across generations (i.e., disorder‐specific transmission), often overlooking the possibility that a general tendency to develop various forms of anxiety might be passed from parents to offspring (i.e., transdiagnostic transmission).
